identity.description: Google Ads API is a programmatic interface for managing Google Ads accounts and campaigns, with GAQL reporting, campaign/asset management, conversion uploads, and a lead form webhook.
identity.identity_notes: Sources describe Google Ads developer docs and Google Ads API.

auth.oauth_flows: Single-user and multi-user user authentication (authorization code with offline refresh token); service account workflow.
auth.token_refresh: Access tokens expire after one hour; request offline access to get a refresh token.
auth.scopes_notes: Scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords; a developer token is also required in addition to OAuth credentials.

access.production_restrictions: Developer token and API access level required (Test, then Explorer via application, automatically reviewed in most cases); OAuth app verification recommended for multi-user apps.

api.limitations: Developer token and API access level required.

claims.quote: Just like other Google APIs, Google Ads API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization.
Once you complete your application, Google automatically reviews your application and upgrades it to Explorer access in most cases.

open_questions: The protocols list includes WebSocket and gRPC, but the sources only show REST and client libraries, so those two are unconfirmed.
Does the developer token require approval? S9 says one is required, but the sources don't describe how to get it.
Test accounts are mentioned, but the sources don't describe how they work.
